title: PFAS in Food Contact Materials: FDA Phase-Out & State Bans
excerpt: The FDA completed its voluntary phase-out of PFAS grease-proofing agents in February 2024 and revoked 35 food contact notifications in January 2025. At least 12 states have enacted their own PFAS food packaging bans, with compliance deadlines ranging from 2023 to 2032. This page tracks the full federal, state, and international regulatory landscape for PFAS in food contact materials, seafood, cosmetics, and drinking water.
seo_title: PFAS Food Packaging Bans: FDA & State Regulations | Policy Canary
seo_description: Complete regulatory intelligence on PFAS in food contact materials. FDA revoked 35 food contact notifications (compliance deadline June 30, 2025). 12+ state bans in effect. EPA drinking water MCLs. MoCRA cosmetics report. Deadlines, affected categories, and compliance steps.
